params.s0: 0..1 switch 1 off (lever away) to on (lever toward the viewer, lit yellow); s1 .. s7 the same for switches 2 to 8
params.more: 0..1 switches 4 to 8 fade in one after another (init 1: all eight shown)
params.r0: -1..1 lamp 1: -1 red (the rule fails), 0 grey, 1 green (the rule holds); r1, r2 lamps 2 and 3
